instructions: Cut 8 slices of the sourdough and toast them in the toaster until they're deep golden and crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, spoon the ricotta into a bowl. Add 1 tbsp of the honey and the 1/4 tsp salt and beat it hard with a fork for about 1 minute, until it's smooth and looks a little fluffy.
Spread the ricotta thickly over the warm toast, right to the edges.
Drizzle the other 2 tbsp honey over the toasts. Scatter on the pistachios and grind a little black pepper over the top.
Serve right away, while the toast is still crisp.
method_notes: Both versions spread ricotta on toasted sourdough or crusty bread and finish with honey. Well and Full (the lead) blends the ricotta smooth with a little honey, salt and pepper before piping it on, then adds more honey on top. Tastefully Grace leaves the ricotta plain and tops it with harissa honey, crushed salted pistachios, thyme and a pinch of salt. This one beats a little honey and salt into the ricotta with a fork, keeps the honey plain and adds pistachios for crunch. No version had 20 or more ratings and RecipeTin Eats (the trusted cook for Italian) has no ricotta toast, so the first read version leads.
